definitions.explanation: A complete meal offered at a fixed price, typically including a main dish, rice, miso soup, and side dishes. Common at Japanese restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧{定食|ていしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll have the grilled fish set meal, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定食|ていしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The set meals at this restaurant are cheap and delicious.

examples.english: The set meal comes with miso soup and pickles.

notes:
COMPOUND: {定|てい} (fixed, regular) + {食|しょく} (meal)

TYPICAL {定食|ていしょく} COMPONENTS:
- Main dish (meat, fish, etc.)
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice)
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ (miso soup)
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickles)
- ⟦{小鉢|こばち}→小鉢：19968_kobachi⟧ (small side dishes)

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧{定食|ていしょく} (grilled fish set)
- ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧{定食|ていしょく} (fried chicken set)
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}カツ→豚カツ：noentry⟧{定食|ていしょく} (pork cutlet set)
- ⟦{生姜焼|しょうがや}き→生姜焼き：27981_shougayaki⟧{定食|ていしょく} (ginger pork set)
- ⟦{日替|ひが}わり→日替わり：09745_higawari⟧{定食|ていしょく} (daily special set)

{定食|ていしょく} is a popular, economical lunch option in Japan.
